answer: The cheapest real defence: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because gale only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, zephyr is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any ridge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
